3. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a wide pan; brown chicken thighs 4 min per side over medium-high heat.
4. Add 200 g canned tomatoes, 2 tbsp Greek yogurt, 100 ml vegetable stock, 1 tsp dried oregano; stir and simmer 10 min until chicken is cooked through (75°C internal).
5. Add 80 g spinach (Diego) / 60 g (Diana); stir until wilted 1 min.
6. Serve sauce & chicken over penne.

day_of_steps: 1. Preheat oven to 200°C. Tear two large sheets of baking paper.

3. Scatter sliced bell pepper 70 g + cherry tomatoes 50 g over each fillet; season with dried oregano, dried thyme, garlic powder, black pepper, drizzle 1 tsp olive oil per person.

5. Pour boiling water over couscous 70 g (Diego) / 50 g (Diana) in bowls; cover 5 min; fluff with fork; stir in 0.5 tsp olive oil.
6. Open parcels at table; serve fish and veg juices over couscous.

meals.image_prompt: golden chickpeas and roasted aubergine slices with bell peppers in tomato-paprika sauce over couscous, overhead, terracotta bowl, Mediterranean light
day_of_steps: 1. Slice 150 g courgette (used in place of aubergine for palette compliance); toss with 1 tsp olive oil + smoked paprika + garlic powder; roast at 200°C 15 min.
2. In a pan, heat 1 tsp olive oil; add 200 g canned tomatoes + 1 tsp cumin + 1 tsp smoked paprika + 100 ml vegetable stock; simmer 5 min.
3. Add drained chickpeas — 100 g (Diego) / 75 g (Diana) — simmer 5 min.
4. Pour boiling water over couscous 70 g (Diego) / 50 g (Diana); cover 5 min; fluff.

meals.name: Soy-Ginger Baked Tilapia with Stir-Fried Mushrooms & Broccoli on Brown Rice
meals.image_prompt: soy-ginger glazed tilapia fillets on a bed of brown rice with stir-fried mushrooms and broccoli, sesame drizzle, white oval plate, warm evening light
day_of_steps: 1. Cook brown rice — rinse 70 g (Diego) / 50 g (Diana); simmer 25 min in salted water; drain.
2. Preheat oven to 200°C. Place tilapia (Diego 200 g / Diana 140 g) on lined tray; mix 1.5 tbsp soy sauce + 1 tsp sesame oil + 1 tsp ground ginger; spoon over fillets; bake 15 min.
3. Stir-fry 100 g sliced mushrooms + 100 g broccoli (Diego) / 80 g mushrooms + 80 g broccoli (Diana) in 1 tsp sesame oil in a wok 4 min; add dash soy sauce.
4. Plate rice, top with stir-fried veg then tilapia. Drizzle with remaining soy-ginger glaze.
